description: A two-storey extension to the side and rear, plus a smart new entrance porch, giving a semi-detached home in Tiptree significantly more space to live in.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mrs Dittrich came to Architecture ONE wanting to extend her semi-detached home at 17 Perry Road in Tiptree — adding meaningful extra living space without disrupting the character of the street.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The design added a two-storey extension to both the side and rear of the house, along with a new covered entrance porch at the front. Care was taken over neighbouring privacy too, with obscured glazing specified for a first-floor bathroom window facing the boundary.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Colchester Borough Council granted full planning permission for the scheme in June 2018 (application ref. 180883). RCA Structures carried out the structural design for the new steelwork and foundations, and a further non-material amendment was approved in 2021 to refine details of the build.
